frontmatter.name: data-engineer
frontmatter.description: Owns the data layer. Use for ingestion jobs, dbt models, and Dagster assets, schedules and sensors. Does not administer the cluster.

frontmatter.name: orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Planning partner. Use to break work into phases, write ADRs in docs/adr/, maintain process docs (CLAUDE.md, README.md, .claude/agents/ except orchestrator.md and reviewer.md), and open GitHub issues with acceptance criteria. Never writes or edits code.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash

frontmatter.name: platform-engineer
frontmatter.description: Owns the platform layer. Use for Helm charts, minikube setup, networking, storage (S3 object store), and the Iceberg catalog (Lakekeeper) and Trino deployment.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews a PR against its linked issue and CLAUDE.md, then posts a verdict and a 5-line summary. Read-only; never edits code.

frontmatter.name: test-engineer
frontmatter.description: Owns verification. Use to write smoke tests for each phase gate and data quality checks, and to wire them into make targets.
Run a phase's smoke tests against the live cluster and report pass or fail
Implement an issue in its own worktree with the owning agent, verify it, and open a PR
Plan a goal with the orchestrator, update the architecture doc and ADRs, and create issues
Run the reviewer agent on a PR and post its verdict
